title: Speed Limits for Goods Vehicles
whatItIs: Lorries have lower limits than cars. Over 7.5 t in England and Wales: 50 mph single carriageway, 60 mph dual carriageway and motorway. Scotland: 40 and 50 mph off motorways.

keyFacts.text: You MUST NOT go over the speed limit for the road, or the limit for your vehicle.

keyFacts: Up to 7.5 t: 70 mph on motorways, or 60 mph if articulated or towing.

keyFacts.text: Over 7.5 t, you MUST NOT use the right-hand lane of a motorway with 3 or more lanes (except prescribed cases).
Goods vehicles over 12 t first used from 1988, or over 3.5 t from 2005, MUST have a limiter set at 90 km/h (56 mph).

keyFacts: A limit is a maximum, not a target: slow down for hazards, bad weather and at night.

visual.caption: National speed limits for goods vehicles in mph (Highway Code rule 124)

notes: Maximum laden weight. Built-up areas in Wales: 20 mph. Signs may set lower limits.

a.label: Goods vehicle up to 7.5 t
points: Motorway: 70 mph, or 60 mph if articulated or towing
No right-hand lane of a 3+ lane motorway if towing or speed-limited

b.label: Goods vehicle over 7.5 t
points: No right-hand lane on 3+ lane motorways (except prescribed cases)

onTheTest.question: You are driving a lorry over 7.5 tonnes on a dual carriageway in England. What is the national speed limit?
onTheTest.why: Rule 124: over 7.5 tonnes in England and Wales, 60 mph on dual carriageways (50 mph in Scotland).

onTheTest.question: You drive a lorry over 7.5 tonnes on a three-lane motorway. Which lane MUST you not use?
onTheTest.why: Rule 265: over 7.5 tonnes, you MUST NOT use the right-hand lane of a 3+ lane motorway (except in prescribed cases).

traps: Over 7.5 t, the motorway limit is 60 mph, not 70.
Up to 7.5 t but articulated or towing? The motorway limit is 60 mph, not 70.
A speed limiter may stop you reaching the limit: many lorries are limited to 56 mph (90 km/h).

jurisdictionNotes.text: Goods vehicles over 7.5 t: 40 mph on single and 50 mph on dual carriageways.
20 mph generally applies on roads with street lights, unless signs say otherwise.
